summary_1line: The creature demands a female companion; after threats and moral debate, Victor reluctantly agrees to create one if the monster leaves humanity forever.

image_candidates.scene_text: The creature stands on the icy glacier pleading with Victor, his distorted face twisted with rage and despair beneath the cold mountain sky.
Victor watches the monster leap down the mountainside and vanish across the vast sea of ice like a dark figure fleeing into the wilderness.
Alone at night beside a mountain fountain, Victor raises his hands to the stars and weeps beneath towering dark pines.
